role.zh: 0 = 用密钥解锁；>0 = 任何人用 PoW 解锁
role.en: 0 = key unlock; >0 = anyone unlocks with PoW

cond.en: contains ["ckb_sighash_all", hex(sighash_all)]; sighash_all as in secp256k1_blake160 (witness.lock zeroed)

cond.en: a 3-element nonce tag exists and target = args[0]
